test_title: PYST 24: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: The new digital portal launched by the electrical board allows residents to report power outages or faulty wiring.

Conclusions:

I. Residents can actively help in the upkeep of the electrical grid through the portal.

II. The electrical board no longer requires on-site maintenance crews.
solution:
Given statement: The new digital portal launched by the electrical board allows residents to report power outages or faulty wiring.

Given Conclusions:

I. Residents can actively help in the upkeep of the electrical grid through the portal. → Follow

If residents can report power outrages or faulty wiring through the digital portal, they are actively participating in identifying issues and assisting in the upkeep of the electrical grid.

II. The electrical board no longer requires on-site maintenance crews. → Does not Follow

The statement does not imply that on-site maintenance crews are no longer needed. Reporting issues digitally does not replace repair work.

Thus, Only Conclusion I follows.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
